comment: Independent mkobj.c remove_object() of a boulder destroyed by system shock. A debug-mode Priestess wishes three times for a boulder, each of which drops onto her square, then wishes for a wand of polymorph with 20 charges and zaps it down eight times. zap.c bhitpile() polymorphs the pile; when obj_shudders() picks a boulder, do_osshock() deletes it ('You feel shuddering vibrations.'), and remove_object() calls vision.c recalc_block_point() for the square.
